esqueleto:
fn solve(n: Int, pos: Int, l: Int, r: Int) -> Int
  requires (1 <= n)
  requires (n <= 100)
  requires (1 <= pos)
  requires (pos <= n)
  requires (1 <= l)
  requires (l <= r)
  requires (r <= n)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((not ((l == 1) and (r == n))) or (result == 0))
  ensures ((not ((l == 1) and (r < n))) or (result == ((if ((pos - r) >= 0) then (pos - r) else -(pos - r)) + 1)))
  ensures ((not ((l > 1) and (r == n))) or (result == ((if ((pos - l) >= 0) then (pos - l) else -(pos - l)) + 1)))
  ensures ((not ((((l > 1) and (r < n)) and ((l <= pos) and (pos <= r))) and ((pos - l) < (r - pos)))) or (result == ((((pos - l) + 1) + (r - l)) + 1)))
  ensures ((not ((((l > 1) and (r < n)) and ((l <= pos) and (pos <= r))) and ((pos - l) >= (r - pos)))) or (result == ((((r - pos) + 1) + (r - l)) + 1)))
  ensures ((not (((l > 1) and (r < n)) and (pos > r))) or (result == ((((pos - r) + 1) + (r - l)) + 1)))
  ensures ((not (((l > 1) and (r < n)) and (pos < l))) or (result == ((((l - pos) + 1) + (r - l)) + 1)))
  ensures (result <= (2 * n))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0, 0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
